'''Brian Robinette''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 2nd at [[January 2001 Durham tournament]] on 27 January 2001, according to Henry Jicha's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1680">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-28-durham-north-carolina-1-27-01d1680/ durham-north-carolina-1-27-01], DeckTech (Henry "Henry Ward" Jicha, 28 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-28-durham-north-carolina-1-27-01d1680/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
